description: Layer 3 vision verification cases (manual pre-release). Feed --spec/--actual into Scripts/verify_ui_vision.py; filter with --platform ios|android. Android specs are the Roborazzi baselines recorded by android-fable's ScreenSnapshotTest (./gradlew :app:recordRoborazziDebug).

cases.name: inventory_list_default
cases.notes: List title, rows with thumbnail/placeholder, name + Qty subtitle; accent low-stock badge when applicable.

cases.name: inventory_swipe_use_one
cases.notes: Trailing swipe reveals Use 1 with minus icon in accent red (#ca0013); no confirm dialog.

cases.name: inventory_swipe_remove
cases.notes: Qty=1 row trailing swipe shows Remove with trash icon in accent red (#ca0013).

cases.name: inventory_undo_toast
cases.notes: Bottom toast Item removed + Undo on brand charcoal; toast must not obscure list title hierarchy.

cases.name: item_detail_default
cases.notes: Hero product image, name, category, UPC when known, quantity metadata.

cases.name: welcome_default
cases.notes: MEKASA eyebrow, two-line hero title, subtitle; sticky footer with primary sign-in CTA above outlined Browse UI offline. No Google button when Firebase is not configured.

cases.name: onboarding_household_name
cases.notes: Centred STEP 1 OF 3 eyebrow + Mekasa wordmark, title, subtitle, single labelled field; footer progress bar, Continue CTA and Skip for now link.

cases.name: onboarding_address
cases.notes: STEP 2 OF 3; address field with helper caption; Find nearby stores CTA disabled until typed.

cases.name: onboarding_store_selection
cases.notes: STEP 3 OF 3; stacked store cards with check icon, name, address · distance; first two preselected with accent border; Finish setup CTA.

cases.name: dashboard_default
cases.notes: Home photo hero band with name/address scrim and camera edit button; two stat cards (Low stock accent, Spend green); Needs approval, Low stock and Shopping list sections; charcoal pill nav with centred red FAB.

cases.name: inventory_list_default
cases.notes: Back arrow + Inventory title with N ITEMS · N LOW eyebrow, Add link; search field; category headers in uppercase; rows with thumbnail, name, category · qty, Low chip and Use 1 link.

cases.name: inventory_swipe_use_one
cases.notes: Qty>1 row dragged left reveals accent red (#ca0013) pane with minus icon + Use 1; no confirm dialog.

cases.name: inventory_swipe_remove
cases.notes: Qty=1 row dragged left reveals accent red (#ca0013) pane with trash icon + Remove.

cases.name: inventory_undo_toast
cases.notes: Row removed from list, eyebrow count drops; bottom charcoal pill toast Item removed + Undo; header hierarchy untouched.

cases.name: item_detail_default
cases.notes: Back + Item title with category eyebrow; large image card; name; category / Low stock / source chips; UPC mono; Quantity and Low-stock threshold stepper cards; explanatory caption.

cases.name: shopping_list_default
cases.notes: Shopping list title with N TO BUY eyebrow and Sync low stock link; Add an item outlined button; Needs approval card (warning tint) with Approve/Reject; To buy rows with circle toggle, Auto chip and trash icon.

cases.name: spending_default
cases.notes: Spending title; Week/Month/Year pill toggle with charcoal active segment; hero total card; three category bar cards with amount and % of total.

cases.name: family_default
cases.notes: Family title with household eyebrow; account card with Owner chip and Offline preview badge; Members cards with role chips; Invite someone form.

cases.name: trash_station_dispose
cases.notes: Dispose title with USE ONE BY BARCODE eyebrow; charcoal scanner well (camera permission fallback on JVM); UPC field + Use 1 by barcode CTA; In stock rows with Use 1 links.

cases.name: add_items_hub
cases.notes: Bottom sheet over dimmed dashboard: Add items title + Close; four option cards (Scan barcode, Search products, Voice, Receipt) with tinted icon wells; trash-station shortcut row.

cases.name: add_items_scanner
cases.notes: Sheet step Scan a barcode with back arrow; charcoal scanner well with Allow camera fallback; preview-mode hint; Or type the number field; Look up CTA disabled until 6+ digits.
